title: Punching Shame in the Face
subtitle: Overcoming Shame
description: Has shame kept you from being content in life? For many people shame is a pervasive force that destroys self-worth and overrides or overshadows happiness and contentment. This is an emotional journey for those who have taken this course but I have been told over and over it is life changing. It is now available in video format so you can watch it in the privacy of your own home.

lessons.title: Shadow Boxing - Punching Shame in the Face
lessons.body: Welcome to Shadow Boxing, punching shame in the face, this short course takes you deep into the ways to overcome shame. It exposes how shame works to destroy you from the inside out and hurts every relationship you have including with yourself! This is a very powerful teaching and is life changing!!
